title: useMap/index.ts - Main Orchestrator
content: Map orchestrator composable. State: isZoomed, isLoading, isFrozen, isPaused. API: init(container), dispose(), zoomOut(), freeze(), unfreeze(), setScrollZoom(progress), pause(), resume(). Scene structure: AmbientLight, DirectionalLight, fogGroup (25 clouds), gridGroup, combinedMapGroup (uz + neighbors), labelsGroup.

title: useMap/camera.ts - Camera Control
content: Camera zoom and parallax handling. Constants: INITIAL_CAM_POS {x:0, y:0, z:1200}, PARALLAX_STRENGTH 50, ZOOMED_PARALLAX_STRENGTH 20. Handles zoom animations via TWEEN, mouse-based parallax effect.

title: useMap/loader.ts - SVG Loader
content: Converts SVG files to 3D meshes. Loads Uzbekistan regions and neighboring countries (Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, etc.). Creates ExtrudeGeometry from SVG paths. Positions countries relative to Uzbekistan.

title: useMap/labels.ts - City Labels
content: Manages city label sprites. Region config with label directions: top-right, bottom-right, top-left, bottom-left. Updates positions and proximity based on camera/zoom state. Renders label text as canvas textures.

title: useMap/markers.ts - Region Markers
content: Interactive region markers. White colored markers (COLORS.marker: 0xffffff). Handles click interactions for zoom-to-region. Animates marker pulses when not frozen/zoomed.

title: useMap/grid.ts - Background Grid
content: Background grid rendering. Animates grid pattern. Part of the scene's visual styling.

title: useMap/config.ts - Constants
content: Configuration constants. COLORS: uzbekistan (0xc1a479), uzbekistanHighlight (0xbf9e6b), sea (0xcce5ff), neighbor (0xf5f5f5), marker (0xffffff). Camera positions, animation durations, region configurations.

title: useScrollTransition.ts
content: Smooth scroll state management. Returns: scrollProgress (Ref 0-1 smoothed), isFrozen (Computed >5%), zoomProgress (Computed 0-50%→0-1), cloudProgress (Computed 15-70%→0-1), aboutProgress (Computed 50-100%→0-1), isMapZoomed (Ref), setMapZoomed(fn), reset(fn). Uses RAF interpolation with 0.08 damping, stops at diff<0.0005.
